answers.answer: A `tree:<hash>` certificate names the source tree and excludes the officina’s own bookkeeping; `source_excludes` keeps one officina’s churn from changing another’s certificate (bisellium-main/AGENTS.md:9, 30; bisellium-main/README.md:61-63). Therefore, a changed file leaves the certificate unchanged when it is within the configured excluded bookkeeping scope. The excerpts do not establish the complete hashing algorithm or all excluded paths.
limitations: The packet does not provide the certificate implementation or full exclusion configuration.

answers.answer: Add a new sequential file under `db/migrations/` using the next number, wrap multi-statement SQL in `BEGIN; ... COMMIT;`, and never edit an applied migration. To amend behavior, create the next migration; the applier records SHA-256 hashes and rejects retroactive edits (epoch0-main/README.md:12, 33, 35, 37-39, 41, 43-44). The corpus cannot establish which migrations a running deployment has applied: it documents the ledger mechanism, but provides no live ledger state.
limitations: No deployment database or `schema_migrations` contents are supplied.
